findings.title: 首次来源迁移遗漏旧内部 grant 的更窄动作上限
findings.contract: r2 §4.1: the old exact resource grant ceiling remains a common hard ceiling and widening needs separate precise Native confirmation.
findings.evidence: The initializer reads g.actions but derives allowed_ceiling only from e.entry_actions for history/version/fields restrictions; otherwise NULL. A valid historical Native grant_upsert can narrow g.actions to read while entry actions remain read/write. First macro upgrade then rewrites g.actions from the source union and silently restores write. Legacy diagnostic fallback likewise reports stored entry actions instead of intersecting the precise grant.
findings.correction: Detect the normalized old grant action ceiling, intersect it with the old exact entry when a narrower or explicit restriction exists, persist that ceiling independently, and retain ordinary unrestricted legacy macro expansion. Legacy observations must intersect the actual live grant.
findings.required_verification: A legal pre-source entry read/write + internal grant read only must remain read only after macro consent, future refresh and Headless rotation; only separate exact Native CAS/digest confirmation may restore write. Seed Binding scopes consistently to isolate this limitation.

findings.title: 已有只读宏来源无法被同 Binding 的新明确同意升级
findings.evidence: Existing contexts_policy updates union actions but retain the initial scope_ceiling. Permission apply temporarily adds write to the Binding; projection rebuild resets scopes from unchanged source ceilings. Runtime source filtering therefore denies write despite a committed developer/full approval.
findings.correction: The server must bind the explicitly approved scope expansion to the named policy/version, without expanding unrelated sources. Expired sources require fresh exact action consent; renewing old union actions from a smaller request is unsafe.
findings.required_verification: Start with contexts:* reader/context:read, approve same-Binding developer then full, and verify existing and future Context writes and exact supported canonical/Context actions. Also ensure expired full → reader renewal cannot revive write/full and retains unrelated live sources.

findings.title: 未升级共享连接的有效动作展示未反映会员收窄
findings.evidence: The pre-source fallback returns before intersecting the saved qualification's current membership actions. A legal member_reduce from read/write to read can still display effective write. The original locked execution assertion continues rejecting write.
findings.correction: Apply current original-membership action intersection in the legacy diagnostic fallback as well.
findings.required_verification: Unupgraded exact shared Binding list shows read only after member_reduce while execution continues denying write.
